description: This Java source file defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application. It standardizes API error responses for various exceptions such as NotFoundException, validation errors, malformed JSON payloads, and uncaught exceptions. The class extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler and uses Spring annotations to handle exceptions across controllers within the specified package.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot global exception handler class that provides standardized error responses for various exceptions.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException, returning a 404 response with a structured payload.

methods.name: handleConstraintViolation
methods.description: Handles validation violations such as parameter and path variable constraints, returning a 400 with details of field errors.

methods.name: handleMethodArgumentNotValid
methods.description: Overrides default handling for @Valid validation errors on request bodies, producing a 400 with field error details.

methods.name: handleHttpMessageNotReadable
methods.description: Overrides handling for unreadable/malformed JSON payloads, returning a 400 with the specific parsing error message.

methods.name: handleAll
methods.description: A fallback handler for uncaught exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error with a generic message.

methods.name: baseError
methods.description: Creates a standardized ApiError object with timestamp, status, error, message, and path.
